meta.notes: Fallback market inputs used only when live retrieval fails. Live values replace these at runtime when available.

price.source: Yahoo Finance chart API / Nasdaq quote API (intraday last sale at compile time)

risk_free.source: U.S. Treasury daily par yield curve, 10-year CMT

tsla_beta_observed.method: OLS slope of 5 years of monthly total returns (adjusted close) vs. S&P 500 (^GSPC), 59 observations
tsla_beta_observed.source: Yahoo Finance chart API, computed by tsla_model.data_ingestion

peers.name: General Motors
peers.notes: Debt is JUDGMENT: approximate GM automotive (ex-GM Financial) debt. Captive-finance debt funds a lending book, not operating leverage, so it is excluded. Revenue/NI: FY2025 10-K XBRL.

peers.name: Ford Motor
peers.notes: Debt is JUDGMENT: approximate Company-excluding-Ford-Credit debt. FY2025 net income not available in clean XBRL tags, so excluded from P/E.

peers.name: Rivian Automotive
peers.notes: Debt: XBRL DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount at 2026-06-30. Loss-making, so 0% tax shield assumed in unlevering.

peers.name: Lucid Group
peers.notes: Debt: XBRL DebtLongtermAndShorttermCombinedAmount at 2026-06-30. Very high D/E; low observed beta likely reflects idiosyncratic/financing-driven price action.

peers.name: Fluence Energy
peers.notes: Debt: XBRL ConvertibleLongTermNotesPayable at 2026-06-30. Fiscal year ends Sept 30. Loss-making, so 0% tax shield.
